scanNote:
1-UNITNING BIRINCHI BETI (6-bet). Fon - och rangdagi dunyo xaritasi.

Yuqorida chapda qora qalin harflar bilan 'UNIT 1'. Ostida katta yashil bo'rtma harflar bilan 'People around the World'.

O'ng tomonda to'rtta surat, har birida oq harf yorlig'i va oq bulutcha ichida ma'lumot:
• A - oq bluzkadagi osiyolik qiz stolda mijozning tirnog'ini bo'yamoqda. Bulutcha: 'Lee (25) Tokyo, Japan - manicurist'
• B - kostyum-shimdagi kal boshli erkak stol yonida telefon go'shagini ushlab o'ylanib turibdi. Bulutcha: 'William (47) Boston, USA - businessman'
• C - oq kepkali, oq soqolli kulib turgan qora tanli erkak ikkita chelakda pushti gullar ko'tarib turibdi. Bulutcha: 'Bob (51) London, England - gardener'
• D - gul do'konida yashil sviterdagi soqolli erkak guldasta yasamoqda; atrofda gullar, idishlar, purkagich. Bulutcha: 'Pierre (38) Paris, France - florist'

Mashqlar (chap ustunda):
1) 'Match the descriptions to the people in pictures A - D.' - oltita tavsif, har birida nuqtali joy.
2) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions about each person, as in the example.' - ikki ustunli namuna dialog (ko'k qiya harflar).
3) 'Describe each person as in the example.' - Lee haqida namuna matn (ko'k qiya harflar).
4) 'Match the activities to pictures A - D.' - to'rtta gap.
5) (o'ng pastda) 'Pictures E - L are from Thailand. Look at them and try to guess which word or phrase completes each sentence correctly. Underline the answer you choose.' - oltita gap, har birida qalin harflar bilan ikki variant.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '6'.

⚠ 5-mashqda ko'rsatilgan E - L suratlari KEYINGI BETDA (7-bet).

⚠ 'Lead-in' sarlavhasi 1-mashq ustida turadi (to'q sariq harflar).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the descriptions to the people in pictures A - D.
exercises.instructionUz: Tavsiflarni A - D suratlaridagi odamlarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TASHQI QIYOFA SO'ZLARI.

  Suratlardagi odamlar:
     A  Lee (25), Tokio, Yaponiya - manikyurchi
     B  William (47), Boston, AQSh - tadbirkor
     C  Bob (51), London, Angliya - bog'bon
     D  Pierre (38), Parij, Fransiya - gulfurush


⚠ YoSh HAQIDA GAPIRISh:

  'in his early fifties'
     = ellik-ellik uch yoshlarda
     (o'ninchi yillikning BOShI)

  'in his late forties'
     = qirq yetti-qirq to'qqiz yoshlarda
     (o'ninchi yillikning OXIRI)

  'in her mid-twenties'
     = yigirma besh yoshlarda
     (o'ninchi yillikning O'RTASI)

  ⚠ Qolip: in + egalik olmoshi +
     early / mid- / late + O'NLIK (ko'plikda)

  ⚠ O'nlik HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA:
     twentieS, thirtieS, fortieS, fiftieS


⚠ GAVDA SO'ZLARI:

  tall        - baland bo'yli
  short       - past bo'yli
  slim        - nozik
  of medium build - o'rtacha gavdali
  overweight  - vazni ortiqcha

  ⚠ 'fat' (semiz) QO'POL eshitiladi.
  Odob bilan 'overweight' deyiladi.

  ⚠ 'of medium build' - turg'un ibora.
  'build' bu yerda OT: gavda tuzilishi.


⚠ SOCh VA YUZ:

  going bald   - kal bo'lib borayotgan
  a beard      - soqol
  a moustache  - mo'ylov
  wrinkles     - ajinlar
  a complexion - yuz rangi, teri rangi
  full lips    - to'la lablar
  straight hair - tekis soch

  ⚠ 'a dark complexion' = qora tanli.
  ⚠ 'to go bald' - 'to be bald' emas:
  'go' JARAYoNNI bildiradi.


⚠ 'HE'S GOT' = 'HE HAS GOT'

  Britaniyada egalik 'have got' bilan:
     He's got a beard.
  AQShda: He has a beard.

pairs.left: 1  He's tall and overweight. He's going bald.
pairs.leftUz: U baland bo'yli va vazni ortiqcha. Kal bo'lib bormoqda.
pairs.whyUz:
Suratda B - kal boshli, baquvvat erkak kostyumda.

⚠ 'overweight' = vazni ortiqcha. 'fat' dan
KO'RA ODOBLI so'z.

⚠ 'to go bald' = kal bo'lib bormoq (jarayon).

pairs.left: 2  He is in his early fifties. He is tall and slim and has got a grey beard and a moustache.
pairs.leftUz: U ellik yoshlarning boshida. Baland bo'yli, nozik, oq soqoli va mo'ylovi bor.
pairs.whyUz:
Bob 51 yoshda - 'in his EARLY fifties'
(ellik yillikning BOShI).

⚠ Suratda oq soqolli, oq kepkali erkak.
⚠ 'a beard' = soqol; 'a moustache' = mo'ylov.
⚠ 'grey' bu yerda oqargan soch.

pairs.left: 3  He's got a dark complexion and a few wrinkles.
pairs.leftUz: Uning yuz rangi to'q va bir nechta ajini bor.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a complexion' = yuz/teri rangi.
⚠ 'a wrinkle' = ajin.
⚠ 'a few' = bir nechta (ko'plikda ot bilan).

pairs.left: 4  She's slim with long straight dark hair.
pairs.leftUz: U nozik, uzun tekis qora sochli.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ SIFATLAR TARTIBI: long (uzunlik) →
straight (shakl) → dark (rang) → hair.

⚠ Bu 3-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

⚠ 'hair' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'hairs' emas.

pairs.left: 5  He is in his late forties and of medium build.
pairs.leftUz: U qirq yoshlarning oxirida va o'rtacha gavdali.
pairs.whyUz:
William 47 yoshda - 'in his LATE forties'
(qirq yillikning OXIRI).

⚠ 'of medium build' = o'rtacha gavdali.
Turg'un ibora, 'of' bilan.

pairs.left: 6  She is pretty, with full lips and a friendly smile.
pairs.leftUz: U chiroyli, to'la lablari va samimiy tabassumi bor.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'pretty' AYOL uchun ishlatiladi.
Erkak uchun 'handsome' deyiladi.

⚠ 'pretty' yana RAVISh bo'lishi mumkin:
'pretty good' = ancha yaxshi.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda har bir odam haqida savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Where is Lee from?
  SB: She's from Tokyo, Japan.
  SA: How old is she?
  SB: She's ...
  SA: What does she look like?
  SB: She's ...
  SA: What's her job?
  SB: She's ...

  ⚠ 'SA' va 'SB' = Student A, Student B.


⚠ ENG MUHIM SAVOL:

  'What does she LOOK LIKE?'
     = U qanday KO'RINADI? (tashqi qiyofa)

  'What is she LIKE?'
     = U qanday ODAM? (xarakter)

  ⚠ Ikki savol BUTUNLAY BOShQA!
     look like → tall, slim, dark hair
     be like   → kind, friendly, funny


⚠ 'WHERE IS SHE FROM?'

  'from' HAR DOIM oxirida qoladi.
  ⚠ 'From where is she?' - noto'g'ri.


⚠ KASBNI AYTISh:

  'What's her job?' - 'She's A manicurist.'
  ⚠ Kasb oldidan 'a/an' ARTIKLI ShART!
  ⚠ 'She's manicurist' - XATO.

items.question: How old is she?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'How old ARE you?' - 'to be' bilan.
O'zbekchadagidek 'have' bilan emas.

items.question: What does she look like?
items.answer: She's slim with long straight dark hair.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'look like' - TAShQI QIYoFA.
⚠ 'does' kerak, chunki 'look' oddiy fe'l.

items.question: Where is William from?
items.whyUz: ⚠ Shahar avval, mamlakat keyin - vergul bilan.

items.question: What's his job?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a businessman' - qo'shma ot, BIRGA yoziladi.
Ayol uchun: 'a businesswoman'.

exercises.instructionEn: Describe each person as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'Lee is from Tokyo, Japan. She's in her
   mid-twenties. She is slim, with long
   straight dark hair. She's pretty, with
   full lips and a friendly smile. She's a
   manicurist.'


QOLIP - BESh QADAM:

  1) ISM + is from + ShAHAR, MAMLAKAT
  2) He's/She's in his/her
     early/mid-/late + O'NLIK
  3) gavda + soch tasviri
  4) yuz tasviri
  5) He's/She's a + KASB


⚠ YoShNI AYTISh:

  25 → in her mid-twenties
  38 → in his late thirties
  47 → in his late forties
  51 → in his early fifties

  ⚠ 0-3 → early
     4-6 → mid-
     7-9 → late


⚠ 'WITH' BILAN QO'ShIMChA TAFSILOT:

  'She is slim, WITH long dark hair.'
  = U nozik, sochlari uzun va qora.

  ⚠ 'with' + tana qismi = ega bo'lish.
exercises.exampleEn: Lee is from Tokyo, Japan. She's in her mid-twenties. She is slim, with long straight dark hair. She's pretty, with full lips and a friendly smile. She's a manicurist.
exercises.exampleUz: Li Tokiodan, Yaponiyadan. U yigirma besh yoshlarda. U nozik, uzun tekis qora sochli. U chiroyli, to'la lablari va samimiy tabassumi bor. U manikyurchi.
modelAnswers: William is from Boston, USA. He's in his late forties. He is tall and overweight and he's going bald. He's of medium build. He's a businessman.
Bob is from London, England. He's in his early fifties. He is tall and slim and he's got a grey beard and a moustache. He's a gardener.
Pierre is from Paris, France. He's in his late thirties. He's got a dark complexion and a few wrinkles. He's a florist.
modelAnswersUz: Uilyam Bostondan, AQShdan. U qirq yoshlarning oxirida. U baland bo'yli va vazni ortiqcha, kal bo'lib bormoqda. U o'rtacha gavdali. U tadbirkor.
Bob Londondan, Angliyadan. U ellik yoshlarning boshida. U baland bo'yli va nozik, oq soqoli va mo'ylovi bor. U bog'bon.
Pyer Parijdan, Fransiyadan. U o'ttiz yoshlarning oxirida. Uning yuz rangi to'q va bir nechta ajini bor. U gulfurush.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the activities to pictures A - D.
exercises.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI DAVOMLI ZAMON (present continuous).

  Qolip: am/is/are + fe'l + -ing

  ⚠ Bu zamon AYNAN HOZIR bo'layotgan
  ishni bildiradi - suratdagi ish.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun surat tasvirlashda
  DOIM shu zamon ishlatiladi.


⚠ -ING QO'ShIShNING QOIDALARI:

  carry  → carrying   (oddiy)
  polish → polishing  (oddiy)
  make   → making     (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  talk   → talking    (oddiy)


⚠ 'SOMEBODY'S NAILS':

  'somebody' = kimdir
  "somebody's" = kimningdir (egalik)

  ⚠ Apostrof + s - EGALIK belgisi.


⚠ 'A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS':

  = guldasta.
  ⚠ Fransuzchadan kirgan: 'bu-KEY'
  deb o'qiladi, 't' O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'ON THE PHONE':

  'to talk ON the phone' - predlog 'on'.
  ⚠ 'in the phone' - XATO.

pairs.whyUz:
C suratida Bob ikki chelakda gul ko'tarib turibdi.

⚠ 'to carry' = ko'tarib olib yurmoq.

⚠ 'to polish' = jilolamoq, bo'yamoq.
⚠ 'nail polish' = tirnoq bo'yog'i.
⚠ "somebody's" - egalik apostrofi.

pairs.left: 3  He's making a bouquet of flowers.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a bouquet' = guldasta. Fransuzcha so'z:
'bu-KEY' deb o'qiladi.

⚠ 'to MAKE a bouquet' - 'to do' EMAS.

⚠ 'ON the phone' - predlog 'on'.

⚠ B suratida Uilyam telefon go'shagini
ushlab turibdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Pictures E - L are from Thailand. Look at them and try to guess which word or phrase completes each sentence correctly. Underline the answer you choose.
exercises.instructionUz: E - L suratlari Tailanddan. Ularga qarang va har bir gapni qaysi so'z yoki ibora to'g'ri to'ldirishini taxmin qiling. Tanlagan javobingiz tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAXMIN QILISh MAShQI.

  ⚠ Bu mashqda javobni BILISh shart emas -
  suratlarga qarab TAXMIN qilinadi.
  To'g'ri javoblar 7-betdagi matndan
  ma'lum bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Bu 'predicting' deb ataladi va o'qish
  ko'nikmasining muhim qismi: matnni
  o'qishdan oldin nima haqida ekanini
  taxmin qilish.


SURATLAR (7-betda):
  E - plyajdagi uzun qayiqlar
  F - sholi dalasida ishlayotgan odamlar
  G - qizil fonda an'anaviy raqs
  H - qizil qalampirli taom
  I - somon shlyapali dehqon ayol
  J - daryoda qayiqda baliq ovlash
  K - futbol o'ynayotgan FIL
  L - buddaviylik ibodatxonasi


⚠ TAILAND HAQIDA:

  • Janubi-sharqiy Osiyoda, Xitoydan
    janubda
  • Aholining ko'pi QIShLOQLARDA yashaydi
  • Milliy taom - guruch, o'tkir ziravorlar
  • Buddaviylik mamlakati - ibodatxonalar
    ('temples')
  • Fil - milliy ramz


⚠ 'A TEMPLE' va 'A MOSQUE':

  a temple = ibodatxona (buddaviylik,
     hinduizm)
  a mosque = masjid (islom)
  a church = cherkov (nasroniylik)

  ⚠ Tailand - buddaviy mamlakat, shuning
  uchun 'temple'.

items.whyUz:
Tailand - Janubi-sharqiy OSIYoda, Xitoydan
janubda.

⚠ 'to be located in' = joylashgan.

7-betdagi matnda: 'They are SHORT with
delicate features.'

⚠ 'short' = past bo'yli.

items.uz: Tailandliklar dengiz mahsulotidan tashqari nima yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'We eat RICE with our meals.'

⚠ 'rice' = guruch - Osiyoning asosiy taomi.
⚠ 'spaghetti' - italyan taomi.

G suratida an'anaviy raqs ko'rinadi.
Matnda: 'watching TRADITIONAL dance shows'.

⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin -ING shakli:
'enjoy GOING'.

Tailand - BUDDAVIY mamlakat.

⚠ a temple = ibodatxona (buddaviylik)
⚠ a mosque = masjid (islom)

items.textEn: 6  Most people in Thailand live in 6) ............ .
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Most people in Thailand live in
VILLAGES.'

⚠ 'most people' - artiklsiz: 'the most people'
EMAS.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Shahar AVVAL, mamlakat KEYIN - vergul bilan.
⚠ 'from' bilan kelib chiqish aytiladi.

⚠ 0-3 → early, 4-6 → mid-, 7-9 → late.
⚠ O'nlik HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA: twentieS, fiftieS.

patterns.formula: What does he/she look like? - He's/She's [tashqi qiyofa].
patterns.exampleEn: What does she look like? - She's slim with long dark hair.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - U nozik, uzun qora sochli.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'look like' = TAShQI qiyofa.
⚠ 'be like' = XARAKTER. Adashtirmang!

⚠ Kasb oldidan 'a/an' ARTIKLI ShART.
⚠ 'She's manicurist' - XATO.

⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - aynan hozir bo'layotgan ish.
⚠ Suratni tasvirlashda DOIM shu zamon.

wordFormation.introUz: Kasb nomlari va tashqi qiyofa so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Betdagi to'rt kasb - to'rt xil qo'shimcha.
'He's going bald' shu qoidadan: 'go' o'zgarish JARAYoNINI bildiradi.
